resolutions.researcher_notes: Sheet's own cited ref (gig.cn journal.do?id=433198...) is dead (403/geoblocked per known-blocked host list); no web.archive.org snapshot exists for it either (wayback availability API returns empty). Fresh search found a Dec 2017 wire story (same underlying story republished at china5e.com, dated 2017-12-11, and sohu.com, dated 2017-12-08/09 -- one origin, counts as one independent source per project rule). china5e's headline states '首条向柳州输送天然气的长输管道投产' (the first long-distance gas transmission pipeline delivering gas to Liuzhou is commissioned/put into operation) and body confirms '柳江天然气支线管道投产运行' (Liujiang gas branch pipeline commissioned and operating). sohu's fuller account shows the pipeline entering trial operation ('调试运行阶段') on Dec 5 2017, with the reporter noting it was 'only trial operation' ('只是试运行') pending downstream CNG-mother-station completion at time of writing. No later news of any shutdown/decommissioning was found (WebSearch budget exhausted this session; searched via WebFetch-driven DuckDuckGo HTML results instead), and a Feb-2020 EIA amendment filing for this exact project (jz.docin.com/p-2304535844.html, listing-page only, not independently citable for content) shows continued project activity 2+ years after the 2017 trial start. Net: 'operating' is well supported as the pipeline's current status, though the single true origin caps tier at medium rather than high.

china5e.com's article is entirely about this being a 天然气 (natural gas) pipeline delivering gas to Liuzhou -- headline, body and quoted officials all describe gas supply/transport. sohu.com (same wire story, not counted separately) equally confirms. Single true origin, tier medium.

Both china5e.com ('长输管道' in the headline and body) and sohu.com ('天然气长输管道') explicitly classify this as a long-distance transmission pipeline, matching PipelineType=transmission. Same wire-story origin (one independent source), tier medium.

china5e.com states '柳江天然气支线管道于2015年8月28日开工建设' (construction began Aug 28, 2015); sohu.com states '于2015年8月份开工建设' (construction began August 2015). Both confirm ConstructionYear=2015/ConstructionMonth=8 exactly. Same wire-story origin, tier medium.

Recorded value StartYear1=2017/StartMonth1=5 is NOT supported and appears wrong: every dated source found (china5e.com dated 2017-12-11; sohu.com, published 2017-12-08/09, explicitly stating the pipeline 'entered trial operation' on 'Dec 5' of that year -- '今年12月5号管道进入调试运行阶段') points to a December 2017 commissioning/trial-start, not May 2017. Per instructions, not proposing a ref for a disputed value -- flagging the May-vs-December conflict for a separate value-correction workflow (StartMonth1 likely should be 12, not 5; StartYear1=2017 itself is plausibly still correct). No source found supporting May 2017 specifically. This corroborates the prior deep-sweep audit's identical finding (see rows/P7673.json validity entry).

china5e.com: '设计年输量3．70×108Nm3（标方）' (design annual throughput 3.70x10^8 Nm3 = 0.37 bcm/y). sohu.com (direct quote from the pipeline company's Liuzhou branch-station chief): '设计年输量3.7亿立方米' (design annual throughput 3.7 x10^8 m3). Both match recorded Capacity=0.37 bcm/y exactly. Same wire-story origin, tier medium.

No source found stating an operating/design pressure for this segment. Checked china5e.com and sohu.com (neither mentions pressure/MPa) and the docin.com EIA listing page (metadata only, no body text -- confirmed via raw HTML inspection, no 'MPa' or '压力' token present). A DuckDuckGo-HTML search (WebSearch budget exhausted this session) surfaced several additional candidate documents likely to contain engineering specs (a doc88.com completion/acceptance opinion '竣工环境保护验收意见' at doc88.com/p-5367840743625.html; a Baidu Wenku feasibility study 'wenku.baidu.com/view/b9b9690a25c52cc58ad6be2d.html'; the original (pre-amendment) docin.com EIA at jz.docin.com/p-729495871.html) but all are paywalled/preview-only with no accessible body text (verified by fetch -- listing metadata only, or 403), and a Guangxi provincial-government land-use approval page (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn) was unreachable (ECONNREFUSED, consistent with the known gxzf.gov.cn geo-blocking pattern) with no wayback snapshot found. Legitimate UNRESOLVED -- no fabricated value proposed.

china5e.com: '线路长度27千米' (route length 27 km). sohu.com (quoting the pipeline company's branch-station chief): '管线全长27公里' (total pipeline length 27 km). Both match recorded LengthKnown=27.00 km exactly. Same wire-story origin, tier medium.

china5e.com: '该管道起于中缅天然气管道支干线柳州输气站' (this pipeline originates at a Liuzhou gas station on a branch trunk of the China-Myanmar natural gas pipeline), matching recorded FuelSource='Sino-Myanmar Gas Pipeline' exactly. sohu.com corroborates the same tie-in more loosely ('由原来的液态天然气，再加入中缅天然气' -- gas source will add China-Myanmar gas alongside existing LNG trucking) but china5e.com is the clearer statement, so cited alone here. Single true origin, tier medium.

china5e.com: pipeline '终于柳南区太阳村镇新圩村柳州分输站...沿线经过柳江区、柳南区两个区' (ends at the Liuzhou distribution station in Xinxu village, Taiyangcun town, Liunan District; route passes through Liujiang District and Liunan District) -- confirms both Start and End Prefecture/District=Liuzhou, State/Province=Guangxi. sohu.com (direct quote): '起点是在柳江区流山镇流山村柳州输气站，经过十二个村到柳南区太阳村镇新圩村柳州分输站' (starting point is the Liuzhou gas station in Liushan village, Liushan town, Liujiang District; passes through twelve villages to the Liuzhou distribution station in Xinxu village, Taiyangcun town, Liunan District) -- confirms StartLocation=Liujiang District and EndLocation=Liunan District precisely. Same wire-story origin, tier medium.

sohu.com directly quotes '广西广投天然气管网有限公司柳州分输站站长 刘卫东' (Liu Weidong, station chief of Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipe Network Co Ltd's Liuzhou distribution station) describing this exact pipeline's route and specs (27 km, Liujiang-to-Liunan) -- an exact match to recorded Operator='Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipe Network Co Ltd', and tied specifically to this segment (not just the parent network), which is stronger support than the previously-considered jz.docin.com/p-2304535844.html EIA-filing listing page (checked directly: that page's HTML contains only the document title/metadata, no company name anywhere in the accessible text -- verified by raw-HTML inspection -- so it is NOT cited here despite being flagged as a lead in the prior deep-sweep audit). Single true origin (part of the same wire story as the other Liujiang-Branch refs), tier medium.
